cover_letter:
Dear Wellhub Recruitment Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Staff Product Manager position for the Occupational Health bet within New Ventures. With over 8 years of experience building and validating 0-to-1 digital products, designing AI-native architectures, and leading GTM enablement under strict compliance frameworks, I am excited to help rebuild corporate occupational health at AI speed.

My background is uniquely suited to the entrepreneurial, high-ambiguity challenge of this 0-to-1 build. As Co-Founder and Product Manager of Meu Barzin, I took complete ownership of building a conversational MVP from concept to validation. I partnered with engineering leads to design the product architecture using ManyChat, n8n, and Supabase hosted on a VPS. Understanding the risks of LLM hallucinations in customer-facing tools, I established a RAG-based database containing metadata for 200+ local establishments and structured strict prompts to enforce zero-hallucination rules. This AI-first MVP generated 505 unique qualified leads and a 22.3% deep-funnel engagement rate, validating our business thesis rapidly and cost-effectively.

Additionally, I am highly comfortable operating in regulated and compliance-heavy environments. At Wipro (supporting the Meta Project), I operated in a highly restricted daily environment, studying compliance risks extensively. I actively participated in building the Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and authored internal governance manuals detailing what data could and could not be shared externally. I completed rigorous Wipro and Meta training programs in information security, policy compliance, anti-phishing, social engineering prevention, and physical security (tailgating). At Meu Barzin, I also ensured that our conversational pipelines strictly complied with the WhatsApp Business Platform policies and Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD).

My academic background in Philosophy equips me with a unique framework for AI safety and ethics. In occupational health, where systems handle sensitive psychosocial assessments and triage, mitigating algorithmic bias related to race and gender is not just a feature—it is an existential requirement. I am committed to building systems that enforce strict confidentiality and ethical guidelines. Furthermore, as a dedicated practitioner of Yoga and Mindfulness, I live Wellhub's mission daily, and I am eager to combine my compliance rigor and product building skills to create compliant, wellness-focused solutions that transform the corporate health ecosystem.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to exploring how my experience can contribute to Wellhub's mission.

Sincerely,
Kevin Augusto Vieira

form_answers.question: Have you worked on products operating in highly regulated, heavy-compliance, or complex B2B markets (e.g., HealthTech, InsurTech, HR Tech, FinTech, Occupational Health, or Safety)?
If you answered 'Yes' above, please briefly specify the industry/market (e.g., HealthTech, FinTech, HR Tech) and describe the main compliance or regulatory challenge you faced
form_answers.answer:
Throughout my career, I have managed products operating under strict regulatory, data security, and compliance guidelines:

1. Big Tech Security & Policy Compliance (Meta Project at Wipro): Operating in a highly restricted corporate environment, I actively contributed to the design of the Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and drafted internal data sharing restrictions. I underwent extensive training by Wipro and Meta on global policy compliance, information security (anti-phishing, social engineering), and physical security to safeguard user metadata within CRM sales tools.

2. B2C/Messaging Compliance (Meu Barzin - HealthTech/FoodTech): When designing our conversational AI product on the WhatsApp Business API, we faced strict data privacy constraints under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD). I architected our ManyChat and Supabase pipelines to enforce strict user consent and opt-in frameworks, ensuring user data and location metrics were processed and stored in compliance with digital privacy laws.

3. Web Compliance & LGPD Implementation (AK Branding): While consulting on web development and building high-conversion websites for corporate clients, I was responsible for ensuring full alignment with LGPD. I designed and deployed technical compliance models, including cookie consent policies, privacy policy documentation, and secure contact forms to safeguard visitor data.
